note: Both sets struggle significantly with the two-column layout of the circuit breaker schedule. They frequently group the left and right circuits together (e.g., circuits 1 and 2, or 29 and 30) and incorrectly apply the rating or description of one circuit to both. Both sets also include several vague claims that rely on row numbers rather than circuit numbers. Because they share the same fundamental parsing errors and have a similar number of incorrect or vague claims, they are of equal quality.
